end.parentNote: Ira practised using the slope of a position-time graph to find velocity and explaining graphs as motion stories. They correctly identified steeper position-time lines as greater velocity and horizontal position-time lines as zero velocity. Ira briefly described a flat line as constant velocity, then corrected this later as zero velocity and standing still. At home, ask them to explain what the slope and area mean on one position-time and one velocity-time graph.
